prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1312; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting right knee pain and swelling. The mechanism and force described are consistent with the knee injury documented on initial evaluation. Over the course of 28 visits, care was delivered at a frequency well above what is typical for this type of injury, with near-daily sessions, and additional body regions were added to the treatment plan several weeks after the collision. Examination shows findings that support a knee injury, including effusion and reduced range of motion on flexion, while other orthopedic and neurovascular tests returned within normal limits. The chart notes a remote, minor strain to the same knee that resolved completely with conservative care and no lasting limitation. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.
